title: HL7 interface engine monitor
description: Interface engine monitoring dashboard (Rhapsody / Cloverleaf / Corepoint / Mirth Connect style), 1280 px wide: status counters, alert strip, the table of HL7 v2 connections between the EHR and the lab, radiology, pharmacy and billing systems (red / amber rows, queue depth climbing), and the message log of the selected interface. The selected interface's row is highlighted.

engine.description: Interface engine product and console name shown in the title bar. A real product name is fine.

site.description: Hospital or health system and engine environment. Falls back to brand.aliases.org.
examples: Harbor County Medical Center — PROD engine HCMC-IE01

clock.description: Console date and time as the engine shows it.

counts.description: Connection counters in the summary tiles. Omit to hide the tiles.

queued.description: Connections running with a growing queue (amber).

stopped.description: Connections stopped by an operator or by the engine.

interfaces.description: Connections in the monitor table, worst first (up to 12).

name.description: Connection / route name as configured in the engine.

direction.description: Inbound (to the engine) or outbound (from the engine).

messageType.description: HL7 v2 message type and trigger event.

status.description: Connection state; drives the row colour.

queueDepth.description: Messages waiting in the outbound / inbound queue.

lastMessage.description: Time the last message was processed, HH:MM:SS.

error.description: Last error text shown in the row.

selected.description: Interface shown in the bottom message-log pane.

name.description: Name of the selected interface (should match a row in interfaces).

messages.description: Message log of the selected interface, newest first (up to 8).

text.description: Log text or error detail. Use documentation IPs (192.0.2.x, 198.51.100.x, 203.0.113.x).

alerts.description: Engine alerts in the strip above the table, most severe first (up to 3).
